name: alpine-postgresql
description: Alpine Linux with PostgreSQL database server

scripts.setup:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Initialize PostgreSQL data directory
mkdir -p /var/lib/postgresql/data
mkdir -p /var/log/postgresql
chown -R postgres:postgres /var/lib/postgresql /var/log/postgresql

# Create the Unix socket directory required by PostgreSQL in WSL2
mkdir -p /run/postgresql
chown postgres:postgres /run/postgresql

# Initialize database cluster
su - postgres -c 'initdb -D /var/lib/postgresql/data'

# Configure PostgreSQL to listen on all interfaces (TCP + Unix socket)
echo "listen_addresses = '*'" >> /var/lib/postgresql/data/postgresql.conf
echo "port = 5432" >> /var/lib/postgresql/data/postgresql.conf

# Allow password-authenticated TCP connections from any host
echo "host all all 0.0.0.0/0 md5" >> /var/lib/postgresql/data/pg_hba.conf

# Start PostgreSQL using pg_ctl (WSL2-compatible, no OpenRC needed)
su - postgres -c 'pg_ctl -D /var/lib/postgresql/data -l /var/log/postgresql/postgresql.log start'

# Wait for postgres to be ready
until su - postgres -c 'pg_isready -q'; do sleep 1; done

echo "PostgreSQL setup complete."
scripts.postInstall:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Ensure socket directory exists
mkdir -p /run/postgresql && chown postgres:postgres /run/postgresql

# Start postgres if not already running
if ! su - postgres -c 'pg_isready -q' 2>/dev/null; then
  su - postgres -c 'pg_ctl -D /var/lib/postgresql/data -l /var/log/postgresql/postgresql.log start'
  until su - postgres -c 'pg_isready -q'; do sleep 1; done
fi

echo "PostgreSQL is ready!"
echo "Connect with: psql -U postgres"
